title: Add AL-focused AppSource validation guidance
summary: Six community AppSource knowledge articles with paired good and bad AL samples now cover profile objects, invariant date literals, page extension action placement, UI calls in web-service paths, UsageCategory on searchable entry points, and time-zone offsets. The AppSource review skill routes AL signals to them.
key_points: Adds six AppSource articles, each with good and bad AL examples
Covers profiles as AL objects, invariant date literals, addfirst/addlast action placement, web-service UI calls, UsageCategory, and time-zone offsets
Updates the AppSource review skill to point concrete AL signals at the new guidance
Avoids duplicating privacy, style, security, and upgrade domain rules
quote: add seven community AppSource knowledge articles with paired good and bad AL samples
